exposure: Neonates born to mothers with type 1 diabetes
glycaemic control during each trimester of pregnancy
HbA(1c) levels >55 mmol/mol (>7.2%) measured in the first trimester of pregnancy
outcome: Maternal and neonatal microbiome community composition and function
Microbiota transfer from mother to neonate
cohort: 92 maternal-neonatal dyads (including 50 gravidae with type 1 diabetes)
finding: Maternal type 1 diabetes, glycemic dysregulation in the first trimester, mode of delivery, and intrapartum antibiotic prophylaxis were found to influence neonatal microbiome composition, suggesting their contribution to neonatal microbiome development.
mod_finding: Both delivery mode and intrapartum antibiotic prophylaxis were found to influence neonatal microbiota composition (p=0.001).
birth_weight: Small for gestational age birthweight was associated with neonatal ear-skin microbiome variation (p=0.050)
